style: Stylized 3D toy render. Chunky puppet-like mutants built from stitched burlap, wood, stone and scrap parts. Dusty rust orange and sand palette with hot pink and electric blue glows.
notes: Rewrite (2026-10). Images 1-4 are kept from the 2025 page; their prompts are the originals, trimmed, kept as a record. The page had no story image, so only image 5 is new: gen MutantLoveQuest --only 5, then finish MutantLoveQuest --only 5.

images.prompt: Wide shot at golden hour of two chunky ragdoll mutants embracing on cracked wasteland ground, one with stone legs, the other holding a flamethrower arm, rusted cars and ruins around them.
Low-angle action shot of a chunky ragdoll mutant mid-fight in an arena, stone legs and a flamethrower arm, limbs glowing with colored energy, debris flying.
Close shot of a mutant ragdoll's body changing mid-fight, one arm crackling with energy, a stone leg, a long tongue out, glowing symbols in the air.
Portrait of two chunky mutant ragdolls holding hands, one with stone legs and a tongue, the other with a flamethrower arm, a wasteland sunset and ruined houses behind.

High wide view at golden hour across a cracked orange wasteland valley. On the left, a ramshackle village of scrap-metal shacks around a rusty water tower, with a little shrine built of hubcaps on a hill. Far across the valley on the right, a second scrap village behind a big gate of stacked rusty cars. A dusty broken highway winds between the two villages past wrecked cars, a softly glowing green crater, and a spiked raider buggy kicking up a trail of dust. Tiny chunky puppet-like mutant figures with mismatched limbs walk along the road.
